_sruntime_listener_basis: Fabric API's half of 1.21.6's PacketSendListener change (s6c.json gives back the interface and vanilla's sends): fabric-networking-api-v1 5.0.1's PacketSender / LoginPacketSender.sendPacket take a ChannelFutureListener where 4.5.0's took a PacketSendListener (javap both, same bodies otherwise). Calls are redirected, 1.21.5 implementations / overrides hooked, super calls to the defaults run 1.21.5's default bodies (rt/CbFapiPacketSends over CbPackets' conversion). CenturyBridge's 1.20.5 CbFapiFutureListenerMixin retires: its holder is a ChannelFutureListener doing what the mixin added, handed over as it is by CbPackets.toNetty, and 1.21.6's Connection adds the listener it is given to the write's future itself.

retiredClasses.top/dext/centurybridge/step/v1_20_5/mixi: 1.21.6's Connection.sendInternal adds the ChannelFutureListener it is given to the write's future; CbFutureListenerCallbacks is that listener (its delegate, then FIRE_EXCEPTION_ON_FAILURE, what the mixin added), handed over by CbPackets.toNetty. The mixin's target took a PacketSendListener, gone at 1.21.6 (its CAPTURE_FAILHARD injection is a critical failure there).

overrideHooks.basis: Fabric API 1.21.6's abstract PacketSender.sendPacket(packet, listener): a 1.21.5 implementation's sendPacket(packet, callbacks) gets the listener as a 1.21.5 one (abstract in 1.21.5: no super call)
Fabric API 1.21.6's default PacketSender.sendPacket(payload, listener): a 1.21.5 override gets the listener as a 1.21.5 one; its super call is 1.21.5's default (superRedirects)
Fabric API 1.21.6's default LoginPacketSender.sendPacket(channel, buf, listener), as PacketSender's
